title: 第1930章 过继第1929章 人分好坏钱不分好坏
content_zh:
“如果是罪大恶极之人，父亲也帮吗？”
宋成霖内心有许多疑问。
父亲的某些做法，目前他无法认可。但他不会轻易下结论，他想问得更清楚。
“罪大恶极之人，就让他去死！”
宋成霖突然就松了一口气，父亲并非没有对错，只有金钱。
“所以，父亲收钱办事也要看人。人对了，才帮，对吗？”
“当然！不是所有人，都值得我出手。有些人看一眼就知道不是好东西，多说两句话都想吐，这种人我从不拿正眼瞧他们，更不会收钱替他们办事。”
宋成霖高兴起来。
父亲没有背离心目中想象的伟岸形象，他感到满足感，还有点小兴奋。
“儿子也认为，对待犯人要区别对待。有人是不得已，有人是罪大恶极，岂能等同。”
“你能这么想挺好。”
父子两人一路爬山一路聊。
等爬到山顶，宋成雨哇哇大叫。
“你们怎么才爬上来，我等了你们好久。你们好慢哦！”
陈观楼哈哈一笑，“能爬上来就行！”
山顶风景独好！
宋成霖想到过两天夫子要抽查功课，他开始搜肠刮肚，就眼前的景色和心情做一首诗。他眼巴巴地求救，看着父亲。
陈观楼连连摆手，“我半桶水的水平，读书的事情你别找我。”
宋成霖叹气，父亲是‘文盲’，徒呼奈何。
宋成雨的功课简单，不用发愁，他玩得开心。

远处传来动静。
宋成霖叫来护卫询问，“什么事？”
“启禀公子，娄家杨家几位少爷小姐也来爬山。得知两位公子在山顶，他们想来拜见。不知公子意下如何？”
宋成霖没有擅自做决定，而是先请示陈观楼。
陈观楼挥手，“这里是你的地盘，你拿主意！”
宋成霖点点头，吩咐护卫头子，“不用拦着，让他们过来。”
护卫头子得了吩咐，急忙去办差。
不多久，一群少爷小姐，十来个人，加上随行伺候的小厮丫鬟，乌泱泱一群人涌了上来。
好在山顶平台足够宽敞，再来一倍的人也能容下。
这群人都挺好奇陈观楼的身份，不过他们都有眼力见，先是跟宋成霖两兄弟见礼寒暄。
宋成霖则是主动介绍道：“这位是家父！”
众人赶忙对陈观楼行晚辈礼，“拜见伯父！”
陈观楼：……
有点小尴尬，因为他没带见面礼。
于是乎他掏出一叠银票，一人两张送了出去。
这群少爷小姐，长这么大第一回遇到拿银票当见面礼，一时间不知该作何反应。
宋成霖低头一笑，轻咳一声，示意众人赶紧收下，莫要让父亲为难。
陈观楼：……
好大儿果然稳重知礼，知道替他解围。
“这次不巧，随身没带礼物。两张银票，聊表心意。”

“多谢伯父！”
“这是晚辈收到过的最实用的礼物！”
这帮少爷小姐吃穿不愁。不过手里头都没钱，花钱的地方太多了，每个月的月例银子根本不够用。
content_en:
"If he is a very evil person, will my father help me?"
Song Chenglin had many questions in his heart.
Currently, he cannot approve of some of his father's actions. But he would not jump to conclusions easily and wanted to ask more clearly.
"Let the person who has committed the most heinous crime die!"
Song Chenglin suddenly breathed a sigh of relief. His father was not without right and wrong, only money.
"So, when my father receives money to do things, he also has to look at the person. He will help only when the person is right, right?"
"Of course! Not everyone is worthy of my action. Some people can tell at a glance that they are not a good person, and they will make you want to vomit if you say more than two words. I will never look at such people seriously, let alone pay to do things for them."
Song Chenglin became happy.
My father did not deviate from the great image he imagined in his mind. He felt satisfied and a little excited.
"My son also believes that prisoners should be treated differently. Some are forced to do so, while others commit heinous crimes. How can they be treated the same?"
"That's good of you to think so."
The father and son talked all the way up the mountain.
When they climbed to the top of the mountain, Song Chengyu screamed.
"Why did you climb up? I've been waiting for you for a long time. You are so slow!"
Chen Guanlou laughed, "As long as you can climb up!"
The scenery on the top of the mountain is unique!
Song Chenglin thought that his master would randomly check his homework in the next two days, so he began to write a poem based on the scenery and mood in front of him. He looked at his father desperately for help.
Chen Guanlou waved his hands repeatedly, "I'm only half as good as a bucket of water. Don't ask me about studying."
Song Chenglin sighed, his father was "illiterate" and he couldn't help but say nothing.
Song Chengyu's homework is simple, he doesn't have to worry, he has fun.
There was movement in the distance.
Song Chenglin called the guard and asked, "What's the matter?"
"Master Qi, several young masters and ladies from the Yang family of the Lou family are also coming to climb the mountain. When they learned that the two masters were at the top of the mountain, they wanted to come and see them. What do you think, master?"
Song Chenglin did not make a decision without authorization, but first asked Chen Guanlou for instructions.
Chen Guanlou waved his hand, "This is your territory, you make the decision!"
Song Chenglin nodded and told the guard leader, "No need to stop them, just let them come."
The guard leader received the order and hurriedly went on errands.
Not long after, a group of young masters and ladies, about a dozen of them, plus the servants and maids accompanying them, formed a huge crowd.
Fortunately, the platform at the top of the mountain is spacious enough to accommodate twice as many people.
This group of people were all curious about Chen Guanlou's identity, but they all had good eyesight. They first met and greeted the two brothers Song Chenglin.
Song Chenglin took the initiative to introduce: "This is my father!"
Everyone hurriedly saluted Chen Guanlou as a junior, "Meet my uncle!"
Chen Guanlou:......
It was a little embarrassing because he didn't bring a gift.
So he took out a stack of banknotes and gave two to each person.
This group of young men and women, for the first time in their lives, encountered a banknote as a greeting gift, and they didn't know how to react for a while.
Song Chenglin lowered his head, smiled, coughed slightly, and signaled everyone to accept it quickly and not to embarrass his father.
Chen Guanlou:......
As expected, the good boy is stable and polite, and knows how to help him out.
"Unfortunately, I didn't bring a gift with me this time. Just two banknotes to show my appreciation."
"Thank you uncle!"
"This is the most practical gift this junior has ever received!"
These young masters and ladies have no worries about food and clothing. But I don’t have any money at hand, there are too many places to spend money, and the monthly money is simply not enough.
